name: RabbitMQ 官方指标
description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：rabbitmq-official。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'
